title: 第11章 三境第12章 楚幼仪 我我没有冷淡
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
“我没勾搭呀。”
沈无名试图解释，但看他们的样子也没有听进去，眼看就要动手。
沈无名运起浩然正气，浑身气势在体内萦绕，一股股热气行走经脉。
头顶丝丝儒家才气，凝聚成一团轻烟薄雾般的庆云。
“殷商之旅，其会如林。矢于牧野：维予侯兴，上帝临女，无贰尔心。”
沈无名口中轻吟，这是《诗经?大明》的内容，描述武王伐纣的场面。
随着诗篇一字一句落下，沈无名浑身上下，燃烧着郁郁如同烈日的金焰。
周围更有盘旋着的金色焰火，化作身穿甲胄的金色战士形象。
“第三境的儒修？”为首壮汉面露惊讶，低呼一声。
不过掂量了一番众人的实力，尚且觉得还有胜算，动如惊雷，奔向沈无名。
其余蒙面人也紧随身后，奔行如猛兽，颇有气势，震散了夜色的寒霜。
沈无名并未动弹，只是口中继续念诵，“牧野洋洋，檀车煌煌，驷原彭彭。”
一排手持大盾的金色武士簇拥上前，撞向一众蒙面人，发出沉闷的声响。
顿时，三四个蒙面人体内发出咔嚓之声，多处骨头被撞断，眼睛暴凸飞起。
“维师尚父，时维鹰扬。”
沈无名口中继续诵唱，又一排金色武士单膝跪地，架起火焰流荡的长弓。
一支支流金铁箭像闪电般穿透夜色，咻咻咻刺进剩余蒙面人的体内。
眨眼间，七八个蒙面人便只剩下领头壮汉。
他实力最强，手中长刀横扫，便将袭来的铁箭拨开，左右飘荡不定，快速逼近。
“敢伤我兄弟，今天你这条命的交代在这里。”壮汉见同伙受伤，目眦欲裂。

到了近前，飞跃而起，朝着沈无名扑来，但随即就听到沈无名继续诵诗。
“凉彼武王，肆伐大商，会朝清明！”
头顶才气青云一阵涌动，化为一柄钢铁长矛，如利箭离弦般，闪烁着寒光射来。
“雕虫小技。”
为首壮汉反应敏锐，抡动手中的长刀斩在铁矛上。
“当——”
刺耳的金铁摩擦声响起，阵阵火光迸射，铁矛被斩飞一旁。
“好大的力道！”
斩开这致命一击，壮汉只觉整条手臂几乎失去知觉，微微颤抖，险些握不住刀。
好在此时已来到沈无名身前一尺之处，长刀直袭面门。
“这么快！”
沈无名吓了一大跳，连忙退步后撤，胸中墨家法力涌出。
像操纵儒家法力一般，将其凝聚成一杆长枪。
content_en:
"I didn't hook up."
Shen Wuming tried to explain, but looked at them and didn't listen, and was about to take action.
Shen Wuming mobilized great righteousness, and the whole body's momentum lingered in his body, and waves of hot air traveled through his meridians.
The traces of Confucian wisdom on the top of his head condensed into a cloud of light and mist.
"The journey of the Yin and Shang Dynasties is like a forest. The target is Muye: Wei Yu Hou Xing, God is coming to the daughter, and there is no second thought."
Shen Wuming whispered, this is the content of "The Book of Songs - Ming Dynasty", describing the scene of King Wu's defeat of Zhou.
As the poem fell word by word, Shen Wuming's whole body was burning with gloomy golden flames like the scorching sun.
There were even more golden fireworks hovering around, transforming into the image of a golden warrior wearing armor.
"A Confucian cultivator in the third realm?" The strong man at the head looked surprised and whispered.
However, after weighing everyone's strength, he felt that there was still a chance of winning, so he moved like thunder and ran towards Shen Wuming.
The other masked men followed closely behind, running like wild beasts with great momentum, shaking away the frost of the night.
Shen Wuming did not move, but continued to chant, "Makino is bright, the sandalwood car is bright, and the Siyuan is pengpeng."
A row of golden warriors holding large shields rushed forward and crashed into a group of masked men, making a dull sound.
Suddenly, there was a clicking sound inside the three or four masked men, many bones were broken, and their eyes popped out.
"The master of Wei respects his father, and the eagle of Wei rises at the same time."
Shen Wuming continued to chant, and another row of golden warriors knelt on one knee, setting up long bows with flowing flames.
A branch of gold and iron arrows penetrated the night like lightning, and pierced into the bodies of the remaining masked men.
In the blink of an eye, only the leading strong man was left among the seven or eight masked men.
He was the strongest, and with a sweeping sweep of the long sword in his hand, he pushed away the incoming iron arrows, drifting left and right, approaching quickly.
"If you dare to hurt my brother, your life will depend on this today." The strong man's eyes were split when he saw that his accomplice was injured.
When he got close, he jumped up and rushed towards Shen Wuming, but then he heard Shen Wuming continue to recite poetry.
"King Wu of Liangbi, who brutally attacked the great merchants, will come to the Qingming Dynasty!"
The blue cloud of talent above his head surged, turning into a steel spear, shooting out with a cold light like a sharp arrow leaving its string.
"Little tricks."
The strong man at the head reacted sharply and struck the iron spear with the long knife in his hand.
"When——"
The harsh sound of gold and iron rubbing against each other was heard, bursts of fire burst out, and the iron spears were chopped aside.
"What a force!"
After this fatal blow, the strong man felt that his entire arm was almost numb, trembling slightly, and he could hardly hold the knife.
Fortunately, at this time, he was already a foot in front of Shen Wuming, and the long knife struck directly at his face.
"So fast!"
Shen Wuming was startled and quickly retreated, the Mo family's magic power gushing out from his chest.
It is like manipulating Confucian magic power, condensing it into a spear.
